  • 方法详细资料

    • playEffect

      public void playEffect(Location location, Effect effect)
      Plays an effect to all players within a default radius around a given location. 向给定位置默认半径内的所有玩家播放一个效果。
      参数:
      location - the Location around which players must be to see the effect 玩家必须处于其附近才能看到效果的 Location
      effect - the Effect 要播放的 Effect
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the location or effect is null. It also throws when the effect requires a material or a material data 如果 location 或 effect 为 null 则抛出；当效果需要材料或材料数据时也会抛出

    • playEffect

      public void playEffect(Location location, Effect effect, int id, int data, float offsetX, float offsetY, float offsetZ, float speed, int particleCount, int radius)
      Plays an effect to all players within a default radius around a given location. The effect will use the provided material (and material data if required). The particle's position on the client will be the given location, adjusted on each axis by a normal distribution with mean 0 and standard deviation given in the offset parameters, each particle has independently calculated offsets. The effect will have the given speed and particle count if the effect is a particle. Some effect will create multiple particles. 向给定位置默认半径内的所有玩家播放一个效果。效果将使用提供的材料（如需要则连同材料数据）。粒子在客户端上的位置为给定位置，并在每个轴上按正态分布（均值为 0，标准差由偏移参数给出）进行调整，每个粒子的偏移均独立计算。如果效果是粒子，则将具有给定的速度和粒子数量。某些效果会创建多个粒子。
      参数:
      location - the Location around which players must be to see the effect 玩家必须处于其附近才能看到效果的 Location
      effect - effect the Effect 要播放的 Effect
      id - the item/block/data id for the effect 效果所用的物品/方块/数据 ID
      data - the data value of the block/item for the effect 效果所用的方块/物品数据值
      offsetX - the amount to be randomly offset by in the X axis 在 X 轴上随机偏移的量
      offsetY - the amount to be randomly offset by in the Y axis 在 Y 轴上随机偏移的量
      offsetZ - the amount to be randomly offset by in the Z axis 在 Z 轴上随机偏移的量
      speed - the speed of the particles 粒子的速度
      particleCount - the number of particles 粒子数量
      radius - the radius around the location 位置周围的半径
